name: TeamStarWolf - Stuxnet (S0603) ICS
description: ATT&CK for ICS techniques that ATT&CK v20.0 lists for Stuxnet (S0603), as bound in the Stuxnet case study. Scores indicate membership only.

techniques.comment: xp_cmdshell runs extrac32 to unpack and run Stuxnet from a CAB file. Sources: [30] ATT&CK S0603 v1.5; [1] Symantec W32.Stuxnet Dossier v1.4 (Feb 2011).
Contacts C2 on port 80. Sources: [30] ATT&CK S0603 v1.5; [1] Symantec W32.Stuxnet Dossier v1.4 (Feb 2011).
Malicious SQL in the WinCC database server to reach remote systems. Sources: [30] ATT&CK S0603 v1.5; [1] Symantec W32.Stuxnet Dossier v1.4 (Feb 2011).
Malicious SQL in the WinCC database server to reach remote systems. Sources: [30] ATT&CK S0603 v1.5; [1] Symantec W32.Stuxnet Dossier v1.4 (Feb 2011).

Import Address Table hooks on the APIs that open Step 7 project files. Sources: [30] ATT&CK S0603 v1.5; [1] Symantec W32.Stuxnet Dossier v1.4 (Feb 2011).
Copies the PLC input area once a second, forming a 21-second recording. Sources: [30] ATT&CK S0603 v1.5; [1] Symantec W32.Stuxnet Dossier v1.4 (Feb 2011).
Hard-coded WinCC database password (CVE-2010-2772). Sources: [30] ATT&CK S0603 v1.5; [1] Symantec W32.Stuxnet Dossier v1.4 (Feb 2011). CVE-2010-2772 per [28] NVD.
Hard-coded WinCC database password (CVE-2010-2772). Sources: [30] ATT&CK S0603 v1.5; [1] Symantec W32.Stuxnet Dossier v1.4 (Feb 2011). CVE-2010-2772 per [28] NVD.
SQL inserts a hex-encoded Stuxnet DLL into a database table. Sources: [30] ATT&CK S0603 v1.5; [1] Symantec W32.Stuxnet Dossier v1.4 (Feb 2011).
Sequence C intercepts peripheral output before it reaches the process image. Sources: [30] ATT&CK S0603 v1.5; [1] Symantec W32.Stuxnet Dossier v1.4 (Feb 2011).
Reprograms the PLC and changes critical drive parameters. Sources: [30] ATT&CK S0603 v1.5; [1] Symantec W32.Stuxnet Dossier v1.4 (Feb 2011).
Replays recorded process input so monitoring looks normal. Sources: [30] ATT&CK S0603 v1.5; [1] Symantec W32.Stuxnet Dossier v1.4 (Feb 2011); ATT&CK also cites Langner (2013).
Renames s7otbxdx.dll and drops a malicious replacement. Sources: [30] ATT&CK S0603 v1.5; [1] Symantec W32.Stuxnet Dossier v1.4 (Feb 2011).
Infects OB1 and OB35. Sources: [30] ATT&CK S0603 v1.5; [1] Symantec W32.Stuxnet Dossier v1.4 (Feb 2011).

Reads DP_RECV monitor fields to judge the process state. Sources: [30] ATT&CK S0603 v1.5; [1] Symantec W32.Stuxnet Dossier v1.4 (Feb 2011).
Calls PLC system function blocks such as SFC1. Sources: [30] ATT&CK S0603 v1.5; [1] Symantec W32.Stuxnet Dossier v1.4 (Feb 2011).
